newsitem.title: FRANCE: France urges EU to be firm on Boeing.
newsitem.headline: France urges EU to be firm on Boeing.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Lionel Jospin urged the European Commission on Wednesday to show firmness in its decision on the merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas, a French government spokeswoman said.
She said the government restated its position at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
"The President and the government encouraged the Commission to hold a firm line to ensure that the rules of competition are respected," spokeswoman Catherine Trautmann said after the meeting.
"A need to remind the United States to observe the rules it wants its partners to apply was also recalled," she said.
France's European Affairs Minister Pierre Moscovici said earlier on Wednesday that Boeing's last-minute concessions were not sufficient, in his view, for European approval of the merger.
The French government's remarks came as Competition Commissioner Karel van Miert said the European Commission gave its preliminary approval to the deal and would make a final decision next week.
